styles.name: Traditional Hand-Drawn
styles.look: Hand-drawn lines that wobble slightly and vary in weight, soft painterly colour, paper grain, detailed painted backgrounds.
styles.motion: Full animation on 2s; every drawing slightly different (line boil), follow-through in hair and scarf.

styles.name: Cel Animation
styles.look: Clean uniform outlines, flat opaque fills with one hard shadow tone, a crisp character layer over a softer painted background.
styles.motion: Smooth, consistent motion; no line boil.

styles.name: Limited Animation
styles.look: Same clean cel drawing, simpler background, high contrast.
styles.motion: Few drawings (about 8 a second), held poses, short cycles, slow camera pans over still art.

styles.name: Rotoscope
styles.look: Realistic proportions and grounded anatomy, painterly cel shading, real-place backgrounds.
styles.motion: Natural, weighty movement as if traced from footage.
styles.note: No live footage is used; the realistic motion is a hand-tuned walk/run cycle.

styles.name: Cutout Animation
styles.look: Flat rigid pieces (head, torso, limbs) with card or paper texture and small drop shadows; bold flat colours, simple shapes.
styles.motion: Pieces rotate at joints, about 12 drawings a second, little squash.

styles.name: Anime-Style Animation
styles.look: Pencil-and-colour anime: varied lineweight, detailed eyes with highlights, light cel shading, airy sky.
styles.motion: Fluid key poses, hair and ribbons trailing.

styles.name: Digital 2D Animation
styles.look: Clean digital lines, flat or gradient colour, polished painted backgrounds, soft glow.
styles.motion: Smooth keyframed or rigged motion.

styles.name: Cel Animation (Traditional)
styles.look: Vintage cel: bold outlines, flat colours, hand-painted gouache backgrounds, film grain and soft vignette.
styles.motion: Smooth full animation on cels.

styles.name: Stop Motion Animation
styles.look: Real-looking physical models and sets, soft studio light, shallow depth of field.
styles.motion: Captured frame by frame (12 fps) with a slight wobble between frames.

styles.name: Claymation
styles.look: Plasticine figures with thumb marks, rounded forms, bead-like eyes, warm miniature set, macro blur.
styles.motion: On twos with a small wobble, like real stop motion.

styles.name: Puppet Animation
styles.look: Articulated puppets in fabric and wood, rich materials, dramatic film-like lighting.
styles.motion: Stop motion on 12s with a slight jitter.

styles.name: Silhouette Animation
styles.look: Solid black shapes with no inner lines against a glowing gradient sky.
styles.motion: Clear poses read through outline alone.

styles.name: Manga Style
styles.look: Black and white ink, screentone dots for grey, speed lines, strong contrast.
styles.motion: Dramatic poses, panel-like framing.

styles.name: Watercolor Anime
styles.look: Anime design in translucent watercolour washes, soft edges, pastel palette, paper grain.
styles.motion: Gentle keyframes; washes shimmer between drawings.

styles.name: Anime Pixel Art
styles.look: Anime design built from visible pixels, limited palette, stair-step contours.
styles.motion: Sprite-like stepped motion.

styles.name: Anime Rotoscope
styles.look: Anime faces on realistic body proportions, cel or painterly colour.
styles.motion: Grounded live-action-like motion.
styles.note: Motion is a tuned cycle, not traced footage.

styles.name: Classic American Cartoon
styles.look: Golden-age theatrical cartoon: rubber-hose limbs, gloves, big shoes, round shapes, bold flat colour.
styles.motion: Bouncy squash and stretch, rhythmic run.

styles.name: Modern Television Cartoon
styles.look: Clean vector lines, simple shapes, flat colour, readable silhouettes.
styles.motion: Reusable cycles, controlled pose changes.

styles.name: Limited Animation (TV)
styles.look: TV anime cel art with muted palette.
styles.motion: Even fewer drawings (6 fps), long holds.

styles.name: Full Animation
styles.look: Rich cel art with detailed movement.
styles.motion: Every frame drawn (30 fps), smooth arcs, speed lines on fast action.

styles.name: Cutout Animation (Digital)
styles.look: Digital cutout: clean flat pieces, no texture.
styles.motion: Pieces rotate at joints on 12s.

styles.name: Silhouette Animation (Sunset)
styles.look: Black silhouette against an orange sunset.
styles.motion: Fluid pose-driven motion.

styles.name: Stick Figure Animation
styles.look: Lines and a circle on paper, one accent colour.
styles.motion: Clear, dynamic poses.

styles.name: Flipbook Animation
styles.look: Pencil drawings on the pages of a small book.
styles.motion: Drawings flip at 12 per second; the page corner lifts.

styles.name: Stylized 3D
styles.look: 3D-looking forms with soft gradients, rim light, appealing exaggerated proportions.
styles.motion: Smooth, appealing motion.
styles.note: Drawn in 2D to look 3D; for real 3D use /cartoon-3d.

styles.name: Photorealistic CGI
styles.look: Aims at photographic realism.
styles.motion: Natural physically plausible motion.
styles.note: Not achievable in this 2D engine: this is the closest soft-shaded cinematic look.

styles.name: Low Poly Animation
styles.look: Faceted triangles with flat shading, angular silhouettes.
styles.motion: Smooth motion over simple geometry.

styles.name: Cel-Shaded 3D
styles.look: 3D forms with two-tone hard shading and bold toon outlines.
styles.motion: 3D-like turns with a flat drawn look.

styles.name: Voxel Animation
styles.look: Everything built from cubes; blocky, grid-aligned forms.
styles.motion: Blocky stepped movement.

styles.name: Isometric 3D
styles.look: Angled top-down view with no perspective, clean diorama.
styles.motion: Diagonal grid movement.

styles.name: Digital Clay
styles.look: Clay-like rounded forms with fingerprints, made digitally.
styles.motion: Smooth (not stepped) clay-like motion.

styles.name: 2.5D Animation
styles.look: Flat 2D art arranged in deep layers.
styles.motion: Camera moves through the layers with strong parallax and a slow push.

styles.name: Claymation
styles.look: See Claymation.

styles.name: Puppet Animation
styles.look: See Puppet Animation.

styles.name: Paper Cutout Stop Motion
styles.look: Torn and cut paper with fibre texture and drop shadows, layered sets.
styles.motion: On twos with a small jitter each step.

styles.name: Brick Toy Animation
styles.look: Glossy plastic toy bricks and blocky figures, bright primaries.
styles.motion: Stepped stop-motion on 12s.
styles.note: A generic toy-brick look; no brand names, logos or official figures.

styles.name: Pixilation
styles.look: Real people photographed pose by pose.
styles.motion: Jerky, stepped, sometimes impossible movement.
styles.note: Uses an illustrated figure, not real performers; the stepped timing is the imitated part.

styles.name: Sand Animation
styles.look: Grains of sand on a lightbox, warm backlight, soft grainy shapes.
styles.motion: Images are swept and redrawn into new shapes.

styles.name: Paint-on-Glass Animation
styles.look: Thick wet paint with visible brushstrokes, glowing colours.
styles.motion: Shapes are repainted every frame and flow into each other.

styles.name: Object Animation
styles.look: Everyday objects on a real-looking set.
styles.motion: An object comes alive on twos.

styles.name: Motion Graphics
styles.look: Flat design shapes, icons and interface cards in bold colour.
styles.motion: Pops, slides, scales and rotations with easing.

styles.name: Kinetic Typography
styles.look: Text is the subject: bold type, strong colour.
styles.motion: Words fly, rotate and scale in rhythm.

styles.name: Infographic Animation
styles.look: Charts, icons and numbers in a clean layout.
styles.motion: Bars grow, numbers count up, a donut fills.

styles.name: Logo Animation
styles.look: A brand mark and wordmark on a dark backdrop.
styles.motion: The mark builds, a light sweeps, the name fades in.

styles.name: Whiteboard Animation
styles.look: Black marker lines on white, simple drawings, a hand with a pen.
styles.motion: Drawings appear stroke by stroke.

styles.name: HUD Animation
styles.look: Cyan interface rings, grids, reticles and labels on dark.
styles.motion: Scanning sweeps, rotating rings, pulsing indicators.

styles.name: Liquid Motion
styles.look: Glossy coloured blobs on a dark backdrop.
styles.motion: Shapes stretch, merge and split like liquid.

styles.name: Geometric Animation
styles.look: Squares, circles and triangles in a grid, a few strong colours.
styles.motion: Rotate, scale and swap in a wave.

styles.name: Rotoscope
styles.look: See Rotoscope.

styles.name: Mixed Media Animation
styles.look: Drawing combined with torn paper, halftone photo scraps and tape.
styles.motion: Animated figure inside a moving collage.

styles.name: Surreal Animation
styles.look: Dreamlike sky with floating islands, stairs to nowhere and a drooping clock.
styles.motion: Impossible things drift and bend.

styles.name: Abstract Animation
styles.look: Pure shapes, lines and colour fields, no figures.
styles.motion: Pulses and rotations to a rhythm.

styles.name: Glitch Animation
styles.look: Digital corruption: RGB split, displaced blocks, tearing.
styles.motion: Calm frames broken by bursts of glitch.

styles.name: Psychedelic Animation
styles.look: Saturated swirling colour, patterns everywhere.
styles.motion: Colours cycle and patterns spin continuously.

styles.name: Ink Animation
styles.look: Sumi-e ink: bold black brush contours, grey washes, a red accent.
styles.motion: Flowing strokes that settle.

styles.name: Charcoal Animation
styles.look: Charcoal on paper: dark smudged tones, rough grainy lines.
styles.motion: Contours shift and smudge between drawings.

styles.name: 8-Bit Pixel Art
styles.look: Large pixels, tiny palette, simple sprites.
styles.motion: Short stepped sprite cycles.

styles.name: 16-Bit Pixel Art
styles.look: Finer pixels, richer palette, dithered shading.
styles.motion: Detailed sprite animation.

styles.name: High-Resolution Pixel Art
styles.look: Many small pixels, careful shading, rich palette.
styles.motion: Smooth detailed sprite motion.

styles.name: VHS Animation
styles.look: Soft analogue video: colour bleed, scan lines, tracking noise, on-screen date.
styles.motion: Normal animation with tape wobble and glitches.

styles.name: Retro CGI
styles.look: Early 3D: low-poly faceted models, low-resolution textures, flat lighting.
styles.motion: Smooth but stiff.

styles.name: Dither Animation
styles.look: Patterned pixels (checkerboard/Bayer) standing in for gradients, limited palette.
styles.motion: Stepped pixel motion.

styles.name: Stickman Animation
styles.look: See Stick Figure.

styles.name: Doodle Animation
styles.look: Ballpoint and marker doodles on ruled notebook paper.
styles.motion: Wobbly lines that re-draw a few times a second.

styles.name: Faceless Storytelling
styles.look: Characters without faces; mood from silhouette, colour and setting.
styles.motion: Body language carries the story.

styles.name: Comic Book Animation
styles.look: Bold inks, halftone dots, flat bright colour, speed lines.
styles.motion: Punchy poses and impact.

styles.name: Motion Comic
styles.look: Comic panels with inked borders, captions and speech bubbles.
styles.motion: Pans and zooms inside panels, small movements.

styles.name: Documentary Animation
styles.look: Archival look: sepia map, routes, dates.
styles.motion: A region spreads, a route draws, captions appear.

styles.name: Game-Based Animation
styles.look: A game scene with health bar, minimap and quest text.
styles.motion: Gameplay-style run with HUD updates.

styles.name: Meme Animation
styles.look: Impact-style caption text, hard zooms, an original reaction.
styles.motion: Sudden punch-ins and shakes.
styles.note: Original reactions only; no existing meme characters.

styles.name: AI-Generated Animation
styles.look: Painterly, glossy, slightly unstable detail.
styles.motion: Details shimmer and drift between frames (temporal instability).
styles.note: Imitates the look; nothing is AI-generated.

styles.name: Parallax Storytelling
styles.look: Layered illustrated scenery, soft depth.
styles.motion: Near layers move fast, far layers slow.

styles.name: Motion Capture
styles.look: A marker suit on a capture stage next to the digital rig it drives.
styles.motion: Recorded-looking natural motion transferred to the rig.
styles.note: A simulated capture; no real data.

styles.name: Performance Capture
styles.look: Body and face markers driving a digital character.
styles.motion: Face points move with the performance.
styles.note: A simulated capture; no real data.

styles.name: Procedural Animation
styles.look: A flock at sunset.
styles.motion: Motion comes from rules (cohesion, swirl, noise), not keyframes.

styles.name: Physics-Based Animation
styles.look: Simple cubes on a grid floor.
styles.motion: Gravity, bounce and friction are simulated.

styles.name: Skeletal Animation
styles.look: The character with its bone rig shown on top.
styles.motion: Joints rotate in a hierarchy (FK).

styles.name: Morph Animation
styles.look: A head silhouette and a wolf's.
styles.motion: One outline interpolates smoothly into the other.

styles.name: Particle Animation
styles.look: Thousands of glowing sparks.
styles.motion: Particles swirl, gather into a figure and stream away.

styles.name: Fluid Simulation
styles.look: Ocean waves at sunset with foam and spray.
styles.motion: A wave builds and breaks.
styles.note: A stylised wave, not a real fluid solver.

styles.name: Mechanical Animation
styles.look: Metal gears, a crank and a piston.
styles.motion: Gears mesh at matched speeds and drive the piston.

styles.name: Architectural Animation
styles.look: A glass house at dusk with warm interior light.
styles.motion: A slow camera dolly past the building.

styles.name: Medical Animation
styles.look: A stylised heart, vessels and blood cells with labels.
styles.motion: The heart beats; cells flow; an ECG line runs.
styles.note: Simplified and illustrative, not medical advice.

styles.name: Scientific Animation
styles.look: A bar magnet with field lines in space.
styles.motion: Field lines draw in; a compass follows them.

styles.name: VR Animation
styles.look: The scene as two headset lens views.
styles.motion: Viewer-centred stereo view.
styles.note: A flat video can only show what VR looks like; it is not an immersive VR experience.

styles.name: AR Animation
styles.look: A phone over a real desk shows the character standing on the table.
styles.motion: Placement ring appears, the character pops in.
styles.note: A simulated AR view inside a video.

styles.name: Real-Time Animation
styles.look: The scene inside a game-engine editor with an FPS counter.
styles.motion: Live playback with gizmos.
styles.note: A pre-rendered video that shows the look of a real-time editor.

styles.name: Projection Mapping
styles.look: Coloured light mapped onto a building facade at night, crowd in front.
styles.motion: Bands of light flow; a whale swims across the facade.
styles.note: A simulated projection on a drawn building.

styles.name: Frame-by-Frame Animation
styles.look: Each frame drawn separately; organic shape changes.
styles.motion: Line boil and loose drawing on 12s.

styles.name: Sketch Animation
styles.look: Rough pencil construction lines, little colour.
styles.motion: Loose redrawn strokes.

styles.name: Rubber Hose Animation
styles.look: Black and white 1930s cartoon: tube limbs, white gloves, film scratches.
styles.motion: Bouncy rhythmic loop.

styles.name: Traditional Anime
styles.look: Clean anime cel art, big expressive eyes, detailed sky.
styles.motion: Mix of held poses and fluid action.

styles.name: 90s Retro Anime
styles.look: Cel-era anime: muted palette, film grain, soft glow, hand-drawn lines.
styles.motion: Strong key poses, dramatic framing.

styles.name: Sakuga
styles.look: High-energy anime action drawing.
styles.motion: Every frame drawn, smears and speed lines, camera push.

styles.name: Chibi Animation
styles.look: Oversized head, tiny body, huge eyes.
styles.motion: Bouncy comedic motion.

styles.name: Adult Sitcom Cartoon
styles.look: Flat colours, simple dot eyes, everyday setting.
styles.motion: Limited: holds, mouth flaps, walk cycles.

styles.name: Exaggerated Cartoon
styles.look: Wild proportions, extreme squash and stretch.
styles.motion: Fast, elastic, over the top.

styles.name: Minimalist Cartoon
styles.look: Very few shapes and colours, lots of space.
styles.motion: Economical motion.

styles.name: Comic Strip Animation
styles.look: Newspaper-strip panels, bold outlines, speech bubbles.
styles.motion: Small movements inside panels.

styles.name: Storybook Cartoon
styles.look: Watercolour and pencil like a picture book, warm pastel colour.
styles.motion: Gentle, slow movement.

styles.name: Gothic Cartoon
styles.look: Dark purples and greens, pale skin, spiky silhouettes, moonlit castle.
styles.motion: Theatrical, slightly jerky.
